CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.compact_output_hash_remediated_v1(p_source bytea, p_identity bytea, p_minutes smallint[], p_flags smallint[], p_receipts timestamp with time zone[], p_values double precision[], p_retained integer, p_unaligned integer, p_invalid_price integer, p_invalid_volume integer)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT sha256(p_source||p_identity||array_send(p_minutes)||array_send(p_flags)||array_send(p_receipts)||array_send(p_values)||int4send(p_retained)||int4send(p_unaligned)||int4send(p_invalid_price)||int4send(p_invalid_volume))
$function$
